title: Advanced NPCs: sprites.json
description: One sprite set (ANPCs/<id>/sprites or sprites_<n>). Each animation is <name>.png: frames left to right, the 8 directions top to bottom.

cellHeight.description: Height in pixels of one frame cell.

groundY.description: Pixel row of the feet, from the cell's bottom.

standingHeight.description: Standing body height in pixels above groundY, without held weapons (default: measured from the idle sheets).

directions.description: Informational: rows are always in this order.

animations.description: Names start with idle, walk, run, hit, attack, attack_range, cast, greet or death (e.g. idle_1, attack_2).

actionFrame.description: Attack sheets: the frame (1-based) the blow lands on.
